correctness.rationale: An exact homogeneous normalization produces rational composition dynamics. The critical scalar drift is positive and shows subordinate mass tends to zero; a reciprocal-increment upper bound forces nonsummability. Monotonicity of the subordinate maximum/minimum ratio plus nonsummability proves equalization. The reciprocal increment then converges to (2m+1)/(2m). For r>2 an exact fitness-ratio bound and summable product correction prove strictly positive asymptotic prefactors. The lower-side interior stationary composition follows by solving exact equal-fitness equations. All quantifiers and positive starting-state assumptions are explicit.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Prior global dynamics mostly concerns two types or positive full-support fixed states. At the parameter ratio two, the full-support equilibrium is absent; a theorem assuming one cannot imply this boundary rate. Broader abstract principles remain a residual priority risk.
